title: Quirky Dense Turkish Baked Beans Pide
description: A kid-friendly Turkish dish featuring baked beans in a dense and sour pide, perfect for a snack or light meal, this recipe is egg-free and easy to make.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Gradually add the olive oil and water to the flour mixture, stirring with a fork until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the baked beans over the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the chopped onion and minced garlic over the baked beans.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Place the pide on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the pide from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
